title: 第005章 第八层守护兽第006章 万剑诀天道仙尊的成名绝技
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
华纪55年6月2日，天道仙府第七层演武场的硝烟尚未散尽，上千具静止的上古傀儡还保持着冲锋的姿势。连续破解六层大阵的胜利让所有人都松了一口气，战士们靠在机甲上喝水休息，老修士们围坐在一起，讨论着即将到来的第八层，脸上满是轻松的笑容。
“我看这天道仙尊的家底也快用光了。”青玄子捋着胡须，笑着说道，“毒阵、重力阵、时间阵、空间迷宫，还有傀儡大军，能想到的手段都用了，第八层估计也就是些普通的机关陷阱，难不住我们。”
“没错。”万天仇点头附和，手里把玩着一枚刚从傀儡身上拆下来的灵石，“连时间阵和空间迷宫都破了，还有什么阵法能挡住华夏科技？我赌今天中午之前，我们就能站在第九层的门口。”
周围的人纷纷点头，看向张德华的眼神中充满了崇拜。这一路来，无论多么无解的上古大阵，在张德华和华夏科技面前，都如同纸糊的一般不堪一击。他们坚信，第八层也不会例外。
张德华站在通往第八层的石门前，手指轻轻敲击着冰冷的石门，眉头微微皱起。他总觉得有些不对劲，前六层大阵虽然各有凶险，但都是针对群体的考验，而作为仙府倒数第二层，第八层的考验应该不会这么简单。
“所有人做好战斗准备。”张德华沉声下令，“龙渊机甲全部启动最高防御，灵能护盾发生器预热，随时准备应对突发情况。”
“是！”
战士们立刻行动起来，五十台龙渊机甲呈扇形排列在石门前，肩部的激光炮和导弹发射舱全部打开，淡蓝色的灵能护盾缓缓升起，将所有人笼罩在其中。老修士们也收起了笑容，祭出各自的法宝，神色凝重地盯着石门。
“开门。”
随着张德华一声令下，两名机甲战士上前，双手抓住石门的边缘，同时发力。沉重的石门发出轰隆隆的声响，缓缓向两侧打开。
石门开启的瞬间，一股恐怖到极致的威压如同海啸般喷涌而出，瞬间冲垮了最外层的灵能护盾。走在最前面的三台龙渊机甲如同被重锤击中，连连后退，腿部的液压管瞬间爆了三根，坚硬的合金外壳上出现了密密麻麻的裂纹。
老修士们脸色惨白，纷纷运转全身灵力抵抗威压，修为稍弱的金丹修士直接被压趴在地上，口吐鲜血。凌霄子作为化神中期修士，也忍不住后退了三步，眼神中充满了震惊和恐惧。
“化神……是化神巅峰的威压！”凌霄子失声喊道。
话音未落，一声震耳欲聋的兽吼从石门内传来，响彻整个仙府。吼声带着无上的威严，震得所有人耳膜生疼，头晕目眩，连石壁都在微微颤抖，碎石簌簌落下。
一道金色的身影从石门内缓缓走出，出现在众人面前。
那是一头身高十米的麒麟，浑身覆盖着金色的鳞片，在灯光的照射下闪烁着金属般的光泽。它的头上长着一对螺旋状的犄角，双眼如同燃烧的火球，四肢粗壮有力，蹄子踏在地面上，留下一个个深深的脚印。一条长长的尾巴甩动着，尾尖燃烧着熊熊的金色火焰，周围的空气都被烧得扭曲变形。
“是火麒麟！天道仙尊的坐骑！”万天仇吓得魂飞魄散，声音都在发抖，“古籍上记载，这头火麒麟跟随天道仙尊征战四方，斩杀过三位化神期老祖，实力达到了化神巅峰！当年它一声吼，就能震碎十万大军！”
火麒麟低下头，冰冷的目光扫过众人，如同在看一群蝼蚁。它张开巨口，喷出一道金色的火焰。火焰如同一条奔腾的火龙，带着毁天灭地的威势，向着众人席卷而来。所过之处，坚硬的黑色晶体地面瞬间熔化，变成了红色的岩浆，空气中的温度飙升到了五千度以上。
“启动最高等级灵能护盾！”张德华厉声下令。
“是！”

十台大型灵能护盾发生器同时启动，五道淡蓝色的能量护盾层层叠叠地升起，挡在火焰面前。
“轰——！”
金色火焰重重地撞在护盾上，发出一声惊天动地的巨响。第一道护盾瞬间融化，第二道、第三道、第四道也接连破碎。第五道护盾剧烈地颤抖着，表面布满了蛛网般的裂纹，坚持了不到三秒钟，也轰然破碎。
残余的火焰穿过护盾，向着人群扑去。
“快躲开！”
王铁柱大喊一声，操控机甲挡在最前面。机甲的钛合金外壳瞬间被烧红，发出滋滋的声响。几名跑得慢的战士被火焰扫到，连一声惨叫都没发出来，就瞬间化为了灰烬，连骨头都没剩下。
“小李！”
一个和牺牲战士相熟的班长红着眼睛，就要冲上去，被身边的人死死拉住。
“别去！太危险了！”
张德华看着地上残留的灰烬，拳头紧紧攥着，指节发白，眼中燃烧着熊熊怒火。他从未想过，第八层的考验竟然是一头化神巅峰的守护兽，更没想到，会有战士在这里牺牲。
“所有人后撤五十米！”张德华的声音冰冷刺骨，带着不容置疑的威严，“导弹部队听令！所有灵能导弹，全部锁定火麒麟！给我洗地！”
“收到！”
五十台龙渊机甲同时打开背部的导弹发射舱，一枚枚银白色的灵能导弹呼啸而出，拖着长长的尾焰，如同雨点般射向火麒麟。
“轰轰轰轰轰——！”
震耳欲聋的爆炸声接连响起，整个第八层都在剧烈地颤抖。火焰和浓烟冲天而起，将火麒麟的身影完全笼罩。爆炸产生的冲击波向着四周扩散，将地面上的岩浆吹得四处飞溅。
老修士们目瞪口呆地看着眼前的景象，脸上写满了难以置信。他们从未见过如此恐怖的火力覆盖，数十枚导弹同时爆炸的威力，就算是化神期修士，也很难正面硬抗。
浓烟渐渐散去，火麒麟的身影重新出现在众人面前。
它身上的金色鳞片被炸掉了不少，露出了下面血肉模糊的皮肤，鲜血顺着伤口不断流下，滴在地面上，发出滋滋的声响。它的一条前腿被炸断，无力地垂在身侧，原本威风凛凛的犄角也被炸断了一截。
火麒麟发出一声痛苦而愤怒的咆哮，眼中充满了杀意。它死死地盯着张德华，巨大的身体微微弓起，随时准备发动致命一击。
“太好了！它受伤了！”青玄子激动地大喊起来，“导弹太厉害了！竟然把化神巅峰的火麒麟打成这样！”
content_en:
On June 2, 55 BC, the smoke from the martial arts arena on the seventh floor of Tiandao Immortal Mansion had not yet cleared, and thousands of static ancient puppets still maintained their charging posture. The victory of continuously breaking through the six-layer formation made everyone breathe a sigh of relief. The soldiers leaned on the mecha to drink water and rest. The old monks sat around and discussed the upcoming eighth layer, with relaxed smiles on their faces.
"I think the Tiandao Immortal Lord's wealth is about to be used up." Qing Xuanzi stroked his beard and said with a smile, "Poison arrays, gravity arrays, time arrays, space mazes, and puppet armies, all imaginable methods were used. The eighth floor is probably just some ordinary traps, which will not be able to stop us."
"That's right." Wan Tianqiu nodded in agreement, playing with a spirit stone that had just been removed from the puppet. "Even the time array and the space maze have been broken. What other array can block Huaxia Technology? I bet we can stand at the door of the ninth floor before noon today."
People around him nodded, looking at Zhang Dehua with eyes full of admiration. Along the way, no matter how unsolvable the ancient formation was, it was as vulnerable as paper to Zhang Dehua and Huaxia Technology. They firmly believe that the eighth floor will be no exception.
Zhang Dehua stood in front of the stone door leading to the eighth floor, tapping the cold stone door gently with his fingers, frowning slightly. He always felt that something was wrong. Although the first six levels of the formation had their own dangers, they were all tests for groups. As the penultimate level of the Immortal Mansion, the test on the eighth level should not be so simple.
"Everyone is ready for battle." Zhang Dehua ordered in a deep voice, "All Longyuan mechas activate their highest defense, and their psychic shield generators are preheated, ready to respond to emergencies at any time."
"Yes!"
The soldiers immediately took action. Fifty Longyuan mechas were arranged in a fan shape in front of the stone gate. The laser cannons and missile launch bays on their shoulders were all opened. The light blue psychic shield slowly rose, shrouding everyone in it. The old monks also put away their smiles, presented their magic weapons, and stared at the stone gate solemnly.
"Open the door."
Following Zhang Dehua's order, the two mecha warriors stepped forward, grabbed the edge of the stone door with both hands, and exerted force at the same time. The heavy stone door made a rumbling sound and slowly opened to both sides.
The moment the stone door opened, a terrifying pressure surged out like a tsunami, instantly destroying the outermost psychic shield. The three Longyuan mechas at the front retreated continuously as if they were hit by heavy hammers. Three hydraulic pipes in their legs burst instantly, and dense cracks appeared on the hard alloy shell.
The old monks' faces were pale, and they all used their spiritual power to resist the pressure. The weaker Golden Core monk was directly pressed to the ground, vomiting blood. As a monk in the middle stage of becoming a god, Ling Xiaozi couldn't help but take three steps back, his eyes full of shock and fear.
"God Transformation... is the pressure of the peak of God Transformation!" Ling Xiaozi cried out.
Before he finished speaking, a deafening beast roar came from the stone gate, resounding throughout the entire Immortal Mansion. The roar was so majestic that it made everyone's eardrums hurt and make them dizzy. Even the stone walls were trembling slightly, and gravel fell rustling down.
A golden figure slowly walked out of the stone door and appeared in front of everyone.
It was a ten-meter-tall unicorn, covered with golden scales, shining with a metallic luster under the light. It had a pair of spiral horns on its head, its eyes were like burning fireballs, its limbs were thick and powerful, and its hooves stepped on the ground, leaving deep footprints. A long tail swung, the tip of the tail burning with blazing golden flames, and the surrounding air was burned and distorted.
"It's the fire unicorn! The mount of the Tiandao Immortal!" Wan Tianqiu was so frightened that his voice was trembling. "It is recorded in ancient books that this fire unicorn followed the Tiandao Immortal in all directions and killed three ancestors in the god-transformation stage. Its strength reached the peak of god-transformation! That year it made a soundRoar, it can shatter an army of 100,000 people! "
Huo Qilin lowered his head and glanced at everyone with his cold eyes, as if looking at a swarm of ants. It opened its huge mouth and spit out a stream of golden flames. The flames were like a galloping fire dragon, sweeping towards everyone with the power of destroying the world. Wherever it passed, the hard black crystal ground melted instantly and turned into red magma, and the temperature in the air soared to more than 5,000 degrees.
"Activate the highest level of psychic shield! "Zhang Dehua ordered sternly.
"Yes! "
Ten large psychic shield generators were activated at the same time, and five light blue energy shields rose up layer by layer, blocking the flames.
“Boom——! "
The golden flames hit the shield heavily, making an earth-shattering noise. The first shield melted instantly, and the second, third, and fourth shields also shattered one after another. The fifth shield trembled violently, and its surface was covered with spiderweb-like cracks. It lasted less than three seconds and then shattered.
The remaining flames passed through the shield and rushed towards the crowd.
"Get away! "
Wang Tiezhu shouted and controlled the mecha to block the front. The titanium alloy shell of the mecha burned red instantly, making a sizzling sound. Several soldiers who were running slowly were swept away by the flames, and without even letting out a scream, they were instantly reduced to ashes, with no bones left.
"Xiao Li! "
A squad leader who was familiar with the fallen soldier had red eyes and was about to rush forward, but was held tightly by the people around him.
"Don't go! Too dangerous! "
Zhang Dehua looked at the ashes remaining on the ground, his fists clenched tightly, his knuckles turning white, and his eyes burning with rage. He never thought that the test on the eighth level would be a guardian beast at the peak of divine transformation, and he never thought that a warrior would die here.
“Everyone retreat fifty meters! "Zhang Dehua's voice was cold and biting, with unquestionable majesty, "Missile troops obey orders! All psychic missiles are locked on the Fire Qilin! Wash the floor for me! "
"receive! "
Fifty Longyuan mechas opened the missile launch bays on their backs at the same time, and silver-white psychic missiles roared out, trailing long tail flames and shooting towards the Fire Qilin like raindrops.
“Boom boom boom boom—! "
Deafening explosions sounded one after another, and the entire eighth floor was shaking violently. Flames and thick smoke rose into the sky, completely covering the figure of Fire Qilin. The shock wave generated by the explosion spread in all directions, blowing the magma on the ground flying everywhere.
The old monks looked at the scene in front of them dumbfounded, with disbelief written on their faces. They have never seen such terrifying fire coverage. The power of dozens of missiles exploding at the same time makes it difficult for even monks in the transformation stage to resist head-on.
The thick smoke gradually dissipated, and Huo Qilin's figure reappeared in front of everyone.
A lot of the golden scales on its body were blown off, revealing the bloody skin underneath. The blood continued to flow down the wound and dripped on the ground, making a sizzling sound. One of its front legs was blown off and hung limply by its side, and a section of its originally majestic horns was also blown off.
Fire Qilin let out a painful and angry roar, his eyes filled with murderous intent. It stared at Zhang Dehua, its huge body slightly arched, ready to launch a fatal blow at any time.
"Great! It hurts! Qing Xuanzi shouted excitedly, "The missiles are so powerful!" He actually beat the Fire Qilin who was at the peak of becoming a god like this! "
